# Overview

Turner syndrome (X0) RNA-seq analysis using **GSE126712** — peripheral blood
lymphocytes from a four-karyotype cohort (X0, XX, XY, XXY) generated by the
Skuse / Raznahan groups. Counts are RSEM `expected_count` tables deposited at
GEO; phenotype metadata is fetched live via `GEOquery`.

Three contrasts are run from a single voom fit:

| Contrast | Coef | Question |
|----------|------|----------|
| `XO − XY` | group | Turner monosomy vs. normal male — primary contrast (matches mature MSY-lost LOY in somatic cells) |
| `XO − XX` | group | Turner monosomy vs. normal female — secondary contrast (isolates the lost X copy with the normal X background) |
| `dose`   | linear | X-chromosome dosage gradient (1/2/3 ≡ X0/XX-XY/XXY) — picks out X-dosage-responsive genes regardless of sex |

The dosage model is **Turner-specific** and replaces the cell-line-specific
§8 module that AR / PI3K occupies in the LNCaP base notebook.

Every figure is saved to `figures_X0_vs_XY/` as both PNG (for iterative review)
and PDF (for publication).

**Counts pipeline.** GSE126712 distributes RSEM gene-level tables
(`*.genes.results.txt.gz`), one per sample. Gene IDs are concatenated
`ENSGxxxx.v_SYMBOL`. Y-chromosome (MSY) genes are stripped from the DGEList
because X0 samples lack them entirely and would dominate every contrast; PAR
genes are preserved at the DE level and filtered out only at pathway-analysis
boundaries (matching the canonical policy in
`analysis/02_rnaseq/2.3.1_rnaseq_LNCaP_base.Rmd`).

| Karyotype | n  | X dose | Y dose | Role |
|-----------|----|--------|--------|------|
| XO        | varies | 1      | 0      | Turner monosomy (primary) |
| XX        | varies | 2      | 0      | Normal female (secondary reference) |
| XY        | varies | 1      | 1      | Normal male (primary reference) |
| XXY       | varies | 2      | 1      | Klinefelter trisomy |

# 1. Setup

## 1.1 Load Packages

```{r load-packages}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(data.table)

  library(edgeR)
  library(limma)
  library(GEOquery)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)

  library(fgsea)
  library(msigdbr)

  library(dorothea)
  library(decoupleR)

  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggpubr)
  library(ggrepel)
  library(patchwork)
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  library(ComplexHeatmap)
  library(circlize)
})
```

## 1.2 Paths, Parameters, and PNG-First Figure Helper

```{r define-paths}
# --- Data root ---------------------------------------------------------
# DATA_ROOT is kept canonical (matches LNCaP / A549 / HT1080 base notebooks),
# but the GSE126712 public RSEM tables actually live under the sibling
# `data/` tree (not under `projects/`). Both paths are surfaced below so the
# canonical convention is preserved for any downstream code that uses
# DATA_ROOT, while Turner's GEO inputs resolve correctly.
DATA_ROOT    <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/projects"
GEO_DATA_DIR <- "A:/Dropbox/LOY_paralogs/data/RNAseq/AUG_13_2025_LOY_A549_HT1080/public_data"

# RSEM gene-level expected_count tables, one per sample (.genes.results.txt.gz)
COUNTS_DIR    <- file.path(GEO_DATA_DIR, "GSE126712_RAW")

# GEOquery cache for phenotype metadata (series_matrix.txt.gz)
GEO_CACHE_DIR <- file.path(GEO_DATA_DIR, "GEO_cache")
if (!dir.exists(GEO_CACHE_DIR)) dir.create(GEO_CACHE_DIR, recursive = TRUE)

# --- Output paths ------------------------------------------------------
# This Rmd renders from analysis/02_rnaseq/other/. Outputs are namespaced
# under Turner/ inside that directory to mirror the canonical LNCaP/, A549/,
# HT1080/ layout. CSVs/RDSes are gitignored repo-wide; PNG/PDF figures
# are tracked.
BASE_DIR   <- getwd()
COHORT_DIR <- file.path(BASE_DIR, "Turner")
DE_DIR     <- file.path(COHORT_DIR, "DE")
GSEA_DIR   <- file.path(COHORT_DIR, "GSEA")
TF_DIR     <- file.path(COHORT_DIR, "TF_analysis")
FIG_DIR    <- file.path(COHORT_DIR, "figures_X0_vs_XY")

for (d in c(DE_DIR, GSEA_DIR, TF_DIR, FIG_DIR)) {
  if (!dir.exists(d)) dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE)
}

ALPHA   <- 0.05
LFC_THR <- 0.5

# Save every figure as both PNG (for review) and PDF (for publication)
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width = 7, height = 6, dpi = 300) {
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".png")),
         plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  ggsave(file.path(FIG_DIR, paste0(name, ".pdf")),
         plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi)
  cat(sprintf("Saved: %s.(png|pdf)  [%gx%g in]\n", name, width, height))
  invisible(plot)
}
```

## 1.3 Color Palette (Okabe-Ito)

```{r palette}
# Karyotype colors (Okabe-Ito, colorblind-safe) — matches canonical pipeline
karyotype_cols <- c(
  "XO"  = "#D55E00",   # red — Turner monosomy
  "XX"  = "#009E73",   # green — normal female
  "XY"  = "#0072B2",   # blue — normal male
  "XXY" = "#E69F00"    # orange — Klinefelter trisomy
)

# X-dose gradient (1 / 2 / 3)
dose_cols <- c(
  "1" = "#D55E00",   # monosomy
  "2" = "#009E73",   # disomy
  "3" = "#E69F00"    # trisomy
)

# DE direction colors
direction_cols <- c(
  "Up"   = "#D55E00",
  "Down" = "#0072B2",
  "NS"   = "grey80"
)

# Y-region 4-color palette (canonical, used wherever PAR1/PAR2/MSY-Yp/MSY-Yq
# region categories appear)
y_region_cols <- c(
  "PAR1"   = "#0072B2",
  "PAR2"   = "#56B4E9",
  "MSY-Yp" = "#D55E00",
  "MSY-Yq" = "#E69F00"
)

# Diverging fill for z-scored heatmaps
de_col_fun <- colorRamp2(c(-2, 0, 2), c("#0072B2", "white", "#D55E00"))
```

# 2. Data Loading

## 2.1 Load RSEM Count Data

```{r load-rsem-counts}
rsem_files <- list.files(
  path = COUNTS_DIR,
  pattern = "GSM.*\\.genes\\.results\\.txt\\.gz$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

cat("Found", length(rsem_files), "RSEM gene result files\n")

count_list <- lapply(rsem_files, function(f) {
  dat <- fread(f, data.table = FALSE)
  dat %>%
    dplyr::select(gene_id, expected_count) %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene_id")
})

count_matrix <- do.call(cbind, count_list)
count_matrix <- round(count_matrix)  # integers for edgeR

# Extract GSM accessions from filenames
sample_ids <- basename(rsem_files) %>%
  gsub(pattern = "_\\d+\\.genes\\.results\\.txt\\.gz$", replacement = "")
colnames(count_matrix) <- sample_ids

cat(sprintf("Count matrix: %d genes x %d samples\n",
            nrow(count_matrix), ncol(count_matrix)))
```

## 2.2 Fetch Phenotype Data from GEO

```{r fetch-geo-pheno}
gse <- getGEO("GSE126712", destdir = GEO_CACHE_DIR, GSEMatrix = TRUE)
pheno <- pData(gse[[1]])

if ("geo_accession" %in% colnames(pheno)) {
  samples <- pheno %>%
    dplyr::select(geo_accession, title,
                  karyotype  = `chromosomes:ch1`,
                  individual = `individual:ch1`) %>%
    dplyr::filter(geo_accession %in% colnames(count_matrix))
} else {
  samples <- pheno %>%
    rownames_to_column("geo_accession") %>%
    dplyr::select(geo_accession, title,
                  karyotype  = `chromosomes:ch1`,
                  individual = `individual:ch1`) %>%
    dplyr::filter(geo_accession %in% colnames(count_matrix))
}

samples <- samples %>%
  mutate(
    dose      = case_when(
      karyotype == "XO"                 ~ 1L,
      karyotype %in% c("XX", "XY")      ~ 2L,
      karyotype == "XXY"                ~ 3L
    ),
    karyotype = factor(karyotype, levels = c("XO", "XX", "XY", "XXY"))
  )

count_matrix <- count_matrix[, samples$geo_accession]
stopifnot(all(colnames(count_matrix) == samples$geo_accession))

samples %>%
  group_by(karyotype) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "GSE126712 Sample Summary")
```

## 2.3 Parse Gene Annotations

```{r parse-gene-annotations}
# GSE126712 gene IDs are concatenated as "ENSG00000000003.15_TSPAN6".
# Split into Ensembl-id (versioned + base) and symbol.
gene_info <- data.frame(
  gene_id_full = rownames(count_matrix),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    ensembl_id      = gsub("_.*", "", gene_id_full),
    ensembl_id_base = gsub("\\..*", "", ensembl_id),
    gene_symbol     = gsub(".*_", "", gene_id_full)
  )

# Drop pseudoautosomal-region duplicated entries (ENSGR prefix) — these are
# the chrY copies of PAR genes which are double-counted by the GTF.
keep_genes <- !grepl("^ENSGR", gene_info$ensembl_id)
cat("Removing", sum(!keep_genes), "ENSGR (chrY-PAR duplicate) entries\n")

count_matrix <- count_matrix[keep_genes, ]
gene_info    <- gene_info[keep_genes, ]
rownames(gene_info) <- gene_info$gene_id_full

cat("Genes after ENSGR filter:", nrow(count_matrix), "\n")
```

## 2.4 Create DGEList Object

```{r create-dgelist}
samples_df <- as.data.frame(samples) %>%
  { rownames(.) <- NULL; . } %>%
  column_to_rownames("geo_accession")

dge <- DGEList(
  counts  = count_matrix,
  samples = samples_df,
  genes   = gene_info
)
dge$samples$group <- dge$samples$karyotype

cat(sprintf("DGEList: %d genes x %d samples\n", nrow(dge), ncol(dge)))
```

# 3. QC: Filter, TMM

## 3.1 Library Sizes

```{r qc-library-sizes, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
lib_sizes <- data.frame(
  sample    = colnames(dge),
  lib_size  = dge$samples$lib.size / 1e6,
  karyotype = dge$samples$karyotype
)

p_libsize <- ggplot(lib_sizes,
                    aes(x = reorder(sample, lib_size),
                        y = lib_size, fill = karyotype)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = karyotype_cols) +
  labs(title = "Library Sizes by Sample",
       x = "Sample", y = "Library Size (millions)",
       fill = "Karyotype") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1,
                                   vjust = 0.5, size = 6),
        legend.position = "top")

print(p_libsize)
save_fig(p_libsize, "library_sizes", width = 10, height = 5)
```

## 3.2 Filter Lowly Expressed Genes

```{r filter-genes}
dge_unfiltered <- dge
keep <- filterByExpr(dge, group = dge$samples$karyotype)
dge  <- dge[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]

cat("Before filtering:", nrow(dge_unfiltered), "\n")
cat("After filtering: ", nrow(dge), "\n")
```

## 3.3 TMM Normalization

```{r normalize}
dge  <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
lcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)

dge$samples %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, karyotype, lib.size, norm.factors) %>%
  mutate(lib.size_M = round(lib.size / 1e6, 1)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "First 10 samples — library sizes and norm factors")
```

## 3.4 Density Plots (Pre vs Post Normalization)

```{r density-plots, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
lcpm_raw <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, normalized.lib.sizes = FALSE)

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

plot(density(lcpm_raw[, 1]),
     col = karyotype_cols[as.character(dge$samples$karyotype[1])],
     lwd = 1, ylim = c(0, 0.25), las = 1,
     main = "Raw Log-CPM", xlab = "Log-CPM")
for (i in 2:ncol(lcpm_raw)) {
  lines(density(lcpm_raw[, i]),
        col = karyotype_cols[as.character(dge$samples$karyotype[i])], lwd = 1)
}
legend("topright", legend = names(karyotype_cols),
       col = karyotype_cols, lwd = 2, cex = 0.8)

plot(density(lcpm[, 1]),
     col = karyotype_cols[as.character(dge$samples$karyotype[1])],
     lwd = 1, ylim = c(0, 0.25), las = 1,
     main = "Normalized Log-CPM", xlab = "Log-CPM")
for (i in 2:ncol(lcpm)) {
  lines(density(lcpm[, i]),
        col = karyotype_cols[as.character(dge$samples$karyotype[i])], lwd = 1)
}
legend("topright", legend = names(karyotype_cols),
       col = karyotype_cols, lwd = 2, cex = 0.8)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r mds-analysis, fig.height=5, fig.width=12}

mds_data <- data.frame(
```

# 4. Y Chromosome / PAR Handling

Sanity check: X0 samples lack chrY entirely, so MSY expression should be at
floor in X0 (and similarly in XX). XY and XXY should carry MSY signal. PAR
genes (chrX/chrY shared) should track with X-chromosome dose.

The same canonical filter policy applies as in the LNCaP base notebook:

- **DE flow:** MSY (chrY) is stripped from the DGEList before voom; **PAR
  genes are retained** so they get logFC + FDR values in `topTable`.
- **Pathway flow (fgsea / decoupleR ULM / DoRothEA / GSVA):** both MSY and
  PAR genes are stripped at the rank-vector / matrix input boundary inside
  `prep_ranks_t()` and the equivalent matrix builds — PAR signal in those
  ranks is library-composition artefact (X0 samples lose one PAR copy with
  their lost X), not pathway biology.

## 4.1 Y-region annotation

```{r y-region-annotation}
# Hand-curated PAR gene list (PAR1 + PAR2). PAR genes sit on both sex chroms
# so they should NOT be treated as Y-specific.
PAR_GENES <- c(
  # PAR1
  "CSF2RA", "IL3RA", "SLC25A6", "ASMTL", "P2RY8", "AKAP17A",
  "ASMT", "DHRSX", "ZBED1", "CD99", "XG", "GYG2P1", "ARSD",
  "ARSE", "ARSL", "MXRA5", "PRKX", "NLGN4X", "GTPBP6", "PPP2R3B",
  "SHOX", "CRLF2", "MIC2", "PLCXD1",
  # PAR2
  "SPRY3", "VAMP7", "IL9R", "WASH6P"
)

# Y-chromosome gene symbols from org.Hs.eg.db (MSY ∪ PAR-Y at the annotation
# level; we subtract PAR below to keep MSY-only).
y_genes_entrez <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys     = "Y",
  keytype  = "CHR",
  columns  = c("SYMBOL", "ENSEMBL")
)
y_gene_symbols <- unique(y_genes_entrez$SYMBOL)
y_gene_symbols <- unique(c(y_gene_symbols, "RP11-424G14.1"))

# MSY-only after stripping PAR genes
msy_gene_symbols <- setdiff(y_gene_symbols, PAR_GENES)

# Symbols actually present in our filtered DGE
msy_in_data    <- intersect(msy_gene_symbols, dge$genes$gene_symbol)
par_in_data    <- intersect(PAR_GENES,         dge$genes$gene_symbol)

cat(sprintf("MSY genes (in data, to be stripped from DGE):  %d\n",
            length(msy_in_data)))
cat(sprintf("PAR genes (in data, preserved at DE; stripped at pathway): %d\n",
            length(par_in_data)))
cat("  PAR retained: ", paste(par_in_data, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 4.2 Strip MSY from DGE, keep PAR

```{r remove-y-genes}
msy_idx <- dge$genes$gene_symbol %in% msy_in_data
dge     <- dge[!msy_idx, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat("Genes after MSY removal:", nrow(dge), "\n")

# Map gene symbols to Entrez IDs (downstream pathway annotation expects them).
dge$genes$entrez_id <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                              keys     = dge$genes$gene_symbol,
                              keytype  = "SYMBOL",
                              column   = "ENTREZID",
                              multiVals = "first")
has_entrez <- !is.na(dge$genes$entrez_id)
dge        <- dge[has_entrez, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
cat("Genes after Entrez filter:", nrow(dge), "\n")

# Re-normalize after gene removal
dge  <- calcNormFactors(dge, method = "TMM")
lcpm <- cpm(dge, log = TRUE, normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE)

# Pathway-input exclusion list (chrY ∪ PAR) — used inside prep_ranks_t() and
# at every gene-symbol-keyed matrix build for pathway/TF analyses.
par_gene_names      <- par_in_data
chrY_gene_names     <- msy_in_data            # MSY symbols (already gone from DGE)
excluded_gene_names <- unique(c(chrY_gene_names, par_gene_names))
```

## 4.3 PAR Gene Expression by Karyotype

```{r par-genes-boxplot, fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
par_focus <- c("CSF2RA", "SLC25A6", "DHRSX", "IL3RA", "AKAP17A",
               "ZBED1", "CD99", "GTPBP6", "P2RY8")
par_focus <- intersect(par_focus, dge$genes$gene_symbol)

if (length(par_focus) > 0) {
  par_idx  <- which(dge$genes$gene_symbol %in% par_focus)
  par_expr <- lcpm[par_idx, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(par_expr) <- dge$genes$gene_symbol[par_idx]

  par_long <- par_expr %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(-gene, names_to = "sample", values_to = "expression") %>%
    left_join(
      dge$samples %>% rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
        dplyr::select(sample, karyotype, dose),
      by = "sample"
    )

  p_par <- ggplot(par_long, aes(karyotype, expression, fill = karyotype)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, size = 1, alpha = 0.5) +
    facet_wrap(~ gene, scales = "free_y", ncol = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = karyotype_cols) +
    labs(title = "PAR Gene Expression by Karyotype",
         x = NULL, y = "log-CPM", fill = "Karyotype") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"),
          strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"))

  print(p_par)
  save_fig(p_par, "par_genes_boxplot", width = 12, height = 8)
}
```

# 5. Differential Expression

## 5.1 Helper functions (ranks, fgsea, enrichment, regulon volcano)

All helpers used by GSEA (§7-§9), TF (§10-§11), and cross-method (§12) are
defined here in one place so they're available everywhere downstream. The
key adaptation vs. the existing exploratory turner Rmd: `prep_ranks_t()` now
strips **chrY ∪ PAR ∪ RPS/RPL** at the rank boundary, matching the canonical
LNCaP / A549 / HT1080 pathway-input policy.

```{r helpers}
# Build a signed gene-symbol-keyed rank vector from a limma topTable.
# Drops:
#  - rows missing gene_symbol or t
#  - ribosomal genes (^RPS\d / ^RPL\d) — dominate hallmark ranks with
#    library-composition variance, not biology
#  - chrY (MSY) + PAR — library-composition artefact under X dosage
# Then collapses duplicate symbols by max |stat|.
prep_ranks_t <- function(de_results, gene_col = "gene_symbol",
                          drop_genes = excluded_gene_names) {
  de_results %>%
    dplyr::transmute(gene = .data[[gene_col]], stat = t) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "", is.finite(stat)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!grepl("^RPS\\d|^RPL\\d", gene)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!gene %in% drop_genes) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(gene) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(stat = stat[which.max(abs(stat))], .groups = "drop") %>%
    { setNames(.$stat, .$gene) } %>%
    sort(decreasing = TRUE)
}

# Run fgsea over a named list of pathway collections; bind into one long table
# tagged by `collection`.
run_fgsea_all <- function(ranks, pathways_list,
                          minSize = 15, maxSize = 500) {
  lapply(names(pathways_list), function(name) {
    cat(sprintf("  fgsea: %s  (%d sets)\n",
                name, length(pathways_list[[name]])))
    fgsea(pathways_list[[name]], ranks,
          minSize = minSize, maxSize = maxSize) %>%
      mutate(collection = name) %>%
      arrange(padj)
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()
}

# Pretty dotplot of significant pathways from a `run_fgsea_all` result.
plot_gsea_dotplot <- function(gsea_res, title, n_top = 15,
                              collection_filter = NULL) {
  plot_data <- gsea_res %>% dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05)
  if (!is.null(collection_filter)) {
    plot_data <- plot_data %>%
      dplyr::filter(collection %in% collection_filter)
  }
  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0) {
    return(ggplot() +
             annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
                      label = "No significant pathways") +
             theme_void() + labs(title = title))
  }
  plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(sign(NES)) %>%
    slice_min(padj, n = n_top) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      pathway_clean = gsub("^HALLMARK_|^REACTOME_|^KEGG_|^GOBP_|^GO_",
                           "", pathway),
      pathway_clean = gsub("_", " ", pathway_clean),
      pathway_clean = str_wrap(pathway_clean, 40),
      pathway_clean = fct_reorder(pathway_clean, NES)
    )
  ggplot(plot_data,
         aes(NES, pathway_clean, size = -log10(padj), color = NES)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "#0072B2", mid = "grey80", high = "#D55E00",
                         midpoint = 0) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6), name = "-log10(padj)") +
    labs(title = title, x = "Normalized Enrichment Score (NES)",
         y = NULL, color = "NES") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8))
}

# Publication-grade single-pathway enrichment curve.
make_pub_enrichment <- function(pathway_genes, stats, pathway_label,
                                nes, pval, padj, color = "#D55E00") {
  ord      <- order(stats, decreasing = TRUE)
  stats_s  <- stats[ord]
  gene_set <- names(stats_s) %in% pathway_genes
  n_total  <- length(stats_s)
  n_set    <- sum(gene_set)
  stat_abs <- abs(stats_s)
  stat_abs[!gene_set] <- 0
  running_sum <- cumsum(ifelse(gene_set,
                               stat_abs / sum(stat_abs),
                               -1 / (n_total - n_set)))
  df_run    <- data.frame(rank = seq_along(running_sum), ES = running_sum)
  hit_pos   <- which(gene_set)
  ann_label <- sprintf("NES = %.2f\np = %.3g\npadj = %.3g\nn = %d",
                       nes, pval, padj, n_set)
  ann_x <- if (nes > 0) n_total * 0.65 else n_total * 0.05
  ann_y <- max(abs(df_run$ES)) * 0.65 * sign(nes)

  ggplot(df_run, aes(rank, ES)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(color = color, linewidth = 1) +
    geom_segment(data = data.frame(x = hit_pos),
                 aes(x = x, xend = x, y = -0.02, yend = 0.02),
                 inherit.aes = FALSE,
                 color = color, alpha = 0.5, linewidth = 0.3) +
    annotate("text", x = ann_x, y = ann_y, label = ann_label,
             size = 3.2, hjust = 0, color = "grey20", family = "sans") +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
    labs(title = str_wrap(pathway_label, 50),
         x = "Rank", y = "Enrichment Score") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10, hjust = 0),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
          axis.line  = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.5),
          plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8))
}

# DoRothEA / decoupleR helper: re-sign a rank vector by mode-of-regulation
# so that downstream fgsea picks up activated and repressed targets together.
adjust_stats_by_mor <- function(stats, tf_name, tf_mor_list) {
  mor_vec   <- tf_mor_list[[tf_name]]
  stats_adj <- stats
  shared    <- intersect(names(mor_vec), names(stats_adj))
  stats_adj[shared] <- stats_adj[shared] * mor_vec[shared]
  sort(stats_adj, decreasing = TRUE)
}

# Volcano of DE results with a specific TF regulon overlaid.
make_regulon_volcano <- function(tf_name, de_data, regulon_genes,
                                  nes, padj_val,
                                  gene_col = "gene_symbol",
                                  lfc_col  = "logFC",
                                  pval_col = "P.Value") {
  direction_label <- ifelse(nes > 0, "Activated", "Repressed")
  vol_data <- de_data %>%
    mutate(
      nlp = -log10(pmax(.data[[pval_col]], 1e-300)),
      is_target = .data[[gene_col]] %in% regulon_genes,
      target_cat = case_when(
        !is_target ~ "Other",
        is_target & .data[[pval_col]] < 0.05 & .data[[lfc_col]] < 0 ~
          paste0(tf_name, " — Down"),
        is_target & .data[[pval_col]] < 0.05 & .data[[lfc_col]] > 0 ~
          paste0(tf_name, " — Up"),
        TRUE ~ paste0(tf_name, " — NS")
      ),
      target_cat = factor(target_cat,
                          levels = c("Other",
                                     paste0(tf_name, " — NS"),
                                     paste0(tf_name, " — Up"),
                                     paste0(tf_name, " — Down")))
    )
  target_de <- vol_data %>% dplyr::filter(is_target)
  n_targets <- nrow(target_de)
  n_down    <- sum(target_de[[pval_col]] < 0.05 & target_de[[lfc_col]] < 0)
  n_up      <- sum(target_de[[pval_col]] < 0.05 & target_de[[lfc_col]] > 0)
  top_labels <- target_de %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[pval_col]] < 0.05) %>%
    slice_min(.data[[pval_col]], n = 15)

  target_colors <- c(
    "Other"                                = "grey85",
    setNames("#FDAE61", paste0(tf_name, " — NS")),
    setNames("#D55E00", paste0(tf_name, " — Up")),
    setNames("#0072B2", paste0(tf_name, " — Down"))
  )
  subtitle_text <- sprintf(
    "NES = %.2f, padj = %.1e  |  %d targets (%d dn, %d up; p < 0.05)",
    nes, padj_val, n_targets, n_down, n_up
  )

  ggplot(vol_data, aes(.data[[lfc_col]], nlp, color = target_cat)) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., target_cat == "Other"),
               alpha = 0.3, size = 0.8) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., grepl("NS", target_cat)),
               alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., !grepl("NS|Other", target_cat)),
               alpha = 0.85, size = 2) +
    geom_text_repel(data = top_labels,
                    aes(label = .data[[gene_col]]),
                    size = 2.2, fontface = "italic", max.overlaps = 20,
                    segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.2,
                    box.padding = 0.3, point.padding = 0.2,
                    min.segment.length = 0.15) +
    scale_color_manual(values = target_colors, name = NULL) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
               linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    labs(title = paste0(tf_name, " Regulon (", direction_label, ")"),
         subtitle = subtitle_text,
         x = expression(log[2]~"FC (X0 / XY)"),
         y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          legend.text = element_text(size = 6.5),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                    face = "bold", size = 10),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5,
                                       size = 7, color = "grey30"),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text = element_text(size = 7, color = "black"),
          plot.margin = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 2.5, alpha = 1),
                                nrow = 2))
}
```

## 5.2 Design matrices

```{r design-matrix}
# Group design — one coefficient per karyotype, contrasts built on top.
design_group <- model.matrix(~ 0 + karyotype, data = dge$samples)
colnames(design_group) <- gsub("karyotype", "", colnames(design_group))

# X-dosage design — linear coefficient on numeric dose (1/2/3)
design_dose <- model.matrix(~ dose, data = dge$samples)
colnames(design_dose) <- c("Intercept", "Dose")

cat("Group design:\n");  print(head(design_group))
cat("\nDose design:\n"); print(head(design_dose))
```

## 5.3 Estimate dispersion + voom

```{r voom, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
dge <- estimateDisp(dge, design = design_group, robust = TRUE)

cat(sprintf("Common dispersion: %.4f   BCV: %.3f\n",
            dge$common.dispersion, sqrt(dge$common.dispersion)))

par(mfrow = c(1, 2))
v_group <- voom(dge, design_group, plot = TRUE)
title(main = "voom: group design", line = 0.5, font.main = 2)
v_dose  <- voom(dge, design_dose, plot = TRUE)
title(main = "voom: dose design", line = 0.5, font.main = 2)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## 5.4 Primary contrast: X0 vs XY

```{r de-x0-vs-xy}
fit_group <- lmFit(v_group, design_group)

cm_x0_xy  <- makeContrasts(XO_vs_XY = XO - XY, levels = design_group)
fit_x0_xy <- contrasts.fit(fit_group, cm_x0_xy) %>% eBayes()

de_x0_xy <- topTable(fit_x0_xy, coef = "XO_vs_XY",
                     number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
de_x0_xy$gene_symbol <- dge$genes[rownames(de_x0_xy), "gene_symbol"]
de_x0_xy$ensembl_id  <- dge$genes[rownames(de_x0_xy), "ensembl_id_base"]

cat("=== X0 vs XY ===\n")
summary(decideTests(fit_x0_xy)) %>% print()

cat("\nTop up in X0:\n")
de_x0_xy %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < ALPHA, logFC > 0) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>% print()

cat("\nTop down in X0:\n")
de_x0_xy %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < ALPHA, logFC < 0) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>% print()
```

## 5.5 Secondary contrast: X0 vs XX

```{r de-x0-vs-xx}
cm_x0_xx  <- makeContrasts(XO_vs_XX = XO - XX, levels = design_group)
fit_x0_xx <- contrasts.fit(fit_group, cm_x0_xx) %>% eBayes()

de_x0_xx <- topTable(fit_x0_xx, coef = "XO_vs_XX",
                     number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
de_x0_xx$gene_symbol <- dge$genes[rownames(de_x0_xx), "gene_symbol"]
de_x0_xx$ensembl_id  <- dge$genes[rownames(de_x0_xx), "ensembl_id_base"]

cat("=== X0 vs XX ===\n")
summary(decideTests(fit_x0_xx)) %>% print()
```

## 5.6 Linear dose-response

```{r de-dose}
fit_dose <- lmFit(v_dose, design_dose) %>% eBayes()
de_dose  <- topTable(fit_dose, coef = "Dose", number = Inf, sort.by = "P")
de_dose$gene_symbol <- dge$genes[rownames(de_dose), "gene_symbol"]
de_dose$ensembl_id  <- dge$genes[rownames(de_dose), "ensembl_id_base"]

cat("=== Dose-response (positive = increases with X copy number) ===\n")
summary(decideTests(fit_dose, coef = "Dose")) %>% print()

cat("\nTop dose-positive:\n")
de_dose %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < ALPHA, logFC > 0) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>% print()

cat("\nTop dose-negative:\n")
de_dose %>%
  dplyr::filter(adj.P.Val < ALPHA, logFC < 0) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_symbol, logFC, adj.P.Val) %>% print()
```

# 7. GSEA (Basic Collections)

## 7.1 Load gene-set collections

```{r gsea-collections}
collections <- list(
  hallmark = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H"),
  reactome = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2",
                     subcategory = "CP:REACTOME"),
  kegg     = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C2",
                     subcategory = "CP:KEGG_LEGACY"),
  go_bp    = msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5",
                     subcategory = "GO:BP")
)
pathways <- lapply(collections,
                   function(x) split(x$gene_symbol, x$gs_name))

for (n in names(pathways)) {
  cat(sprintf("  %s: %d gene sets\n", n, length(pathways[[n]])))
}
```

# 8. GSEA (Expanded: CGP + PRC2 / Histone Deep Dive)

The expanded collections (Chemical & Genetic Perturbations, plus a curated
histone-modification subset) are the workhorse for the Turner-specific
hypothesis that loss of one X dose results in spread of repressive
H3K27me3 / loss of bivalent H3K4me3 activating marks at PRC2 targets.

## 8.1 Load CGP + build histone subset

```{r cgp-load}
collections_cgp <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens",
                           category = "C2", subcategory = "CGP")
pathways_cgp <- split(collections_cgp$gene_symbol, collections_cgp$gs_name)
cat(sprintf("CGP gene sets loaded: %d\n", length(pathways_cgp)))

histone_pattern <- "H3K27ME3|H3K4ME3|POLYCOMB|PRC2|EZH2|SUZ12|TRITHORAX|MLL"
histone_sets    <- pathways_cgp[grepl(histone_pattern,
                                       names(pathways_cgp),
                                       ignore.case = TRUE)]
cat(sprintf("Histone-modification CGP sets: %d\n", length(histone_sets)))

# Attach CGP to the pathway list for downstream §12 robustness
pathways$cgp <- pathways_cgp
```

## 8.2 CGP dotplot

```{r cgp-dotplot, fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
# Re-run fgsea adding CGP (others already in gsea_x0_xy)
set.seed(42)
gsea_cgp <- fgsea(pathways_cgp, ranks_x0_xy,
                  minSize = 15, maxSize = 500) %>%
  mutate(collection = "cgp") %>%
  arrange(padj)

gsea_x0_xy_full <- bind_rows(gsea_x0_xy, gsea_cgp)

p_cgp <- plot_gsea_dotplot(gsea_x0_xy_full,
                           "X0 vs XY — CGP (Chemical & Genetic Perturbations)",
                           n_top = 20, collection_filter = "cgp")
print(p_cgp)
save_fig(p_cgp, "gsea_dotplot_cgp", width = 10, height = 12)
```

## 8.3 PRC2 / H3K27me3 — publication enrichment curves

```{r prc2-pub-enrich, fig.height=4, fig.width=10}
prc2_sets <- list(
  BENPORATH_PRC2_TARGETS          = pathways_cgp[["BENPORATH_PRC2_TARGETS"]],
  MIKKELSEN_MEF_HCP_WITH_H3K27ME3 = pathways_cgp[["MIKKELSEN_MEF_HCP_WITH_H3K27ME3"]]
)
set.seed(42)
gsea_prc2 <- fgsea(pathways = prc2_sets, stats = ranks_x0_xy,
                    minSize = 5, maxSize = 2000) %>% as_tibble()

knitr::kable(gsea_prc2 %>% dplyr::select(pathway, NES, pval, padj, size),
             digits = 4,
             caption = "fGSEA: PRC2 Targets & H3K27me3 (X0 vs XY)")

prc2_labels <- c(BENPORATH_PRC2_TARGETS          = "BENPORATH PRC2 TARGETS",
                 MIKKELSEN_MEF_HCP_WITH_H3K27ME3 = "MIKKELSEN MEF HCP WITH H3K27ME3")
prc2_colors <- c(BENPORATH_PRC2_TARGETS          = "#D55E00",
                 MIKKELSEN_MEF_HCP_WITH_H3K27ME3 = "#0072B2")

prc2_plots <- lapply(names(prc2_sets), function(nm) {
  row <- gsea_prc2 %>% dplyr::filter(pathway == nm)
  make_pub_enrichment(prc2_sets[[nm]], ranks_x0_xy,
                      prc2_labels[[nm]], row$NES, row$pval, row$padj,
                      prc2_colors[[nm]])
})
combined_prc2 <- wrap_plots(prc2_plots, ncol = 2)
print(combined_prc2)
save_fig(combined_prc2, "enrichment_PRC2_H3K27me3", width = 10, height = 4)
```

## 8.4 Histone-modification bar plot

```{r histone-bar, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
if (length(histone_sets) > 0) {
  set.seed(42)
  gsea_histone <- fgsea(histone_sets, ranks_x0_xy,
                        minSize = 10, maxSize = 500) %>%
    arrange(padj) %>%
    mutate(direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Up in X0", "Down in X0"),
           histone_type = case_when(
             grepl("H3K27ME3|POLYCOMB|PRC2|EZH2|SUZ12",
                   pathway, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "H3K27me3/PRC2",
             grepl("H3K4ME3|TRITHORAX|MLL",
                   pathway, ignore.case = TRUE) ~ "H3K4me3/Trithorax",
             TRUE ~ "Other"))

  cat(sprintf("Histone CGP sets tested: %d   significant: %d\n",
              nrow(gsea_histone), sum(gsea_histone$padj < 0.05)))

  p_histone <- ggplot(gsea_histone,
                      aes(NES, reorder(pathway, NES), fill = histone_type)) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey50") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("H3K27me3/PRC2"     = "#7570B3",
                                 "H3K4me3/Trithorax" = "#1B9E77",
                                 "Other"             = "grey60")) +
    labs(title = "Histone-modification target enrichment: X0 vs XY",
         subtitle = "H3K27me3 = repressive (PRC2 / EZH2 / SUZ12); H3K4me3 = activating (TRITHORAX / MLL)",
         x = "NES", y = NULL, fill = "Histone Mark") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7), legend.position = "top")

  print(p_histone)
  save_fig(p_histone, "histone_pathway_enrichment",
           width = 10, height = 8)
}
```

# 9. Sex-Chromosome Dosage GSEA

This is the Turner-specific module replacing the LNCaP §8 AR/PI3K block. The
dose coefficient (1=X0, 2=XX or XY, 3=XXY) ranks genes by linear
X-chromosome-copy responsiveness regardless of sex; significant pathways
here implicate biology that scales with X dose rather than with karyotype
identity per se.

## 9.1 Dose-response ranks

```{r dose-ranks}
ranks_dose <- prep_ranks_t(de_dose, gene_col = "gene_symbol")
cat(sprintf("Dose-response ranked list: %d genes  [range %.2f .. %.2f]\n",
            length(ranks_dose), min(ranks_dose), max(ranks_dose)))
cat("(positive = increases with X chromosome dose)\n")
```

## 9.2 Run fgsea (all collections)

```{r dose-gsea}
set.seed(42)
gsea_dose <- run_fgsea_all(ranks_dose,
                            c(pathways, list(cgp = pathways_cgp)))

fwrite(gsea_dose %>%
         mutate(leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")),
       file.path(GSEA_DIR, "dose_response_gsea.csv"))

gsea_dose %>%
  group_by(collection) %>%
  summarise(total   = n(),
            sig_up   = sum(padj < 0.05 & NES > 0),
            sig_down = sum(padj < 0.05 & NES < 0),
            .groups  = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Dose-Response GSEA — significant pathways by collection")
```

## 9.3 Hallmark + CGP dose dotplots

```{r dose-hallmark, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
p_dose_hall <- plot_gsea_dotplot(gsea_dose,
                                  "Dose-Response — Hallmark Pathways",
                                  collection_filter = "hallmark")
print(p_dose_hall)
save_fig(p_dose_hall, "dose_gsea_hallmark", width = 10, height = 10)
```

```{r dose-cgp, fig.height=12, fig.width=10}
p_dose_cgp <- plot_gsea_dotplot(gsea_dose,
                                 "Dose-Response — CGP",
                                 n_top = 20, collection_filter = "cgp")
print(p_dose_cgp)
save_fig(p_dose_cgp, "dose_gsea_cgp", width = 10, height = 12)
```

## 9.4 Dose publication dotplot

```{r dose-pub-dot, fig.height=6, fig.width=5.5}
dose_pub_data <- gsea_dose %>%
  group_by(sign(NES)) %>%
  slice_min(pval, n = 15) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pathway_clean = gsub("^HALLMARK_|^REACTOME_|^KEGG_|^GOBP_|^GO_",
                         "", pathway),
    pathway_clean = gsub("_", " ", pathway_clean),
    pathway_clean = str_to_title(pathway_clean),
    pathway_clean = str_wrap(pathway_clean, 40),
    sig_label = case_when(padj < 0.001 ~ "***",
                          padj < 0.01  ~ "**",
                          padj < 0.05  ~ "*",
                          TRUE          ~ ""),
    pathway_label = paste0(pathway_clean, "  ", sig_label),
    pathway_label = fct_reorder(pathway_label, NES)
  )

p_dose_pub <- ggplot(dose_pub_data,
                     aes(NES, pathway_label,
                         size = -log10(padj), fill = NES)) +
  geom_point(shape = 21, color = "black", stroke = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0072B2", mid = "grey85", high = "#D55E00",
                       midpoint = 0, name = "NES") +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(1.5, 5),
                        name = expression(-log[10](p[adj]))) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
  labs(x = "NES", y = NULL,
       title = "X-chromosome Dosage Response",
       caption = "* padj < 0.05    ** padj < 0.01    *** padj < 0.001") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 8) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5.5, lineheight = 0.85))

print(p_dose_pub)
save_fig(p_dose_pub, "dose_gsea_publication", width = 5.5, height = 6)
```

# 10. TF Regulon Activity (DoRothEA)

## 10.1 Load DoRothEA regulons

```{r dorothea-load}
tf_regulons_raw <- dorothea_hs_pancancer %>%
  dplyr::filter(confidence %in% c("A", "B", "C")) %>%
  dplyr::select(tf, target, mor)

tf_regulons <- tf_regulons_raw %>%
  split(.$tf) %>%
  lapply(function(x) unique(x$target))

tf_mor <- tf_regulons_raw %>%
  group_by(tf, target) %>%
  summarise(mor = mean(mor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  split(.$tf) %>%
  lapply(function(x) setNames(x$mor, x$target))

cat(sprintf("DoRothEA regulons (A/B/C): %d TFs\n", length(tf_regulons)))
```

## 10.2 MoR-weighted fgsea per TF

```{r dorothea-run}
set.seed(42)
tf_gsea_list <- lapply(names(tf_regulons), function(tf_name) {
  targets <- tf_regulons[[tf_name]]
  shared  <- intersect(targets, names(ranks_x0_xy))
  if (length(shared) < 7) return(NULL)
  stats_adj <- adjust_stats_by_mor(ranks_x0_xy, tf_name, tf_mor)
  fgsea(pathways = setNames(list(shared), tf_name),
        stats = stats_adj, minSize = 7, maxSize = 500)
})

tf_gsea <- bind_rows(tf_gsea_list) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(padj = p.adjust(pval, method = "BH")) %>%
  arrange(padj)

cat(sprintf("Significant TFs (padj < 0.05): %d\n",
            sum(tf_gsea$padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)))
fwrite(tf_gsea %>%
         mutate(leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")),
       file.path(TF_DIR, "tf_activity_dorothea.csv"))
```

## 10.3 Top TF tables

```{r dorothea-top}
cat("\n=== Top 15 Activated TFs (NES > 0) ===\n")
tf_gsea %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05, NES > 0) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj, size) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)

cat("\n=== Top 15 Repressed TFs (NES < 0) ===\n")
tf_gsea %>%
  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05, NES < 0) %>%
  head(15) %>%
  dplyr::select(pathway, NES, padj, size) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
```

## 10.4 TF activity volcano

```{r tf-volcano, fig.height=4.5, fig.width=5}
tf_vol_data <- tf_gsea %>%
  mutate(
    nlp = -log10(pmax(padj, 1e-50)),
    sig = padj < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(sig & NES > 0 ~ "Activated",
                           sig & NES < 0 ~ "Repressed",
                           TRUE ~ "NS"),
    direction = factor(direction,
                       levels = c("Repressed", "NS", "Activated"))
  )

tf_top_labels <- bind_rows(
  tf_vol_data %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Activated") %>%
    slice_min(padj, n = 10),
  tf_vol_data %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Repressed") %>%
    slice_min(padj, n = 10)
)
n_act <- sum(tf_vol_data$direction == "Activated")
n_rep <- sum(tf_vol_data$direction == "Repressed")

p_tf_vol <- ggplot(tf_vol_data, aes(NES, nlp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = tf_top_labels,
                  aes(label = pathway),
                  size = 2.5, fontface = "bold.italic", max.overlaps = 30,
                  segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.2,
                  box.padding = 0.35, point.padding = 0.2,
                  min.segment.length = 0.1, force = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Repressed" = "#0072B2",
                                "NS"        = "grey80",
                                "Activated" = "#D55E00"),
                     drop = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = max(tf_vol_data$NES) * 0.7,
           y = max(tf_vol_data$nlp) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("n = ", n_act),
           color = "#D55E00", fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = min(tf_vol_data$NES) * 0.7,
           y = max(tf_vol_data$nlp) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("n = ", n_rep),
           color = "#0072B2", fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "NES", y = expression(-log[10]~"(adjusted p-value)"),
       color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_tf_vol)
save_fig(p_tf_vol, "tf_activity_volcano", width = 5, height = 4.5)
```

```{r tf-dotplot, fig.height=8, fig.width=8}

  dplyr::filter(padj < 0.05) %>%

if (nrow(sig_tfs) > 0) {

                     aes(NES, pathway,
                         size = -log10(padj), color = NES)) +
    geom_point() +

                          midpoint = 0) +
    scale_size_continuous(range = c(2, 6),
                          name = expression(-log[10](p[adj]))) +
    labs(title = "Top significant TFs — X0 vs XY",
         x = "NES", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10)
  print(p_tf_dot)
```

# 11. TF Activity (decoupleR / CollecTRI ULM)

DoRothEA covers ~270 broadly characterized TFs at A/B/C confidence;
CollecTRI is a curated, larger, literature-supported network used by
decoupleR's univariate-linear-model (ULM) inference. Running both gives a
cross-method TF agreement axis (used in §12).

## 11.1 Load CollecTRI network

```{r decouple-net}
net <- get_collectri(organism = "human", split_complexes = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("CollecTRI: %d interactions, %d TFs, %d targets\n",
            nrow(net), n_distinct(net$source), n_distinct(net$target)))
```

## 11.2 Sample-level ULM

Build a symbol-keyed log-CPM matrix (deduplicated) then run ULM with the
CollecTRI network to get per-sample TF activity scores. PAR genes are
stripped at the matrix-build step, matching the canonical pathway-flow
filter policy.

```{r decouple-sample-ulm}
lcpm_sym <- lcpm
sym      <- dge$genes[rownames(lcpm_sym), "gene_symbol"]
keep_sym <- !is.na(sym) & sym != "" & !duplicated(sym)
lcpm_sym <- lcpm_sym[keep_sym, ]
rownames(lcpm_sym) <- sym[keep_sym]

# Strip PAR (chrY is already gone from DGE; PAR still in lcpm)
lcpm_sym <- lcpm_sym[!rownames(lcpm_sym) %in% par_gene_names, ]

sample_acts <- run_ulm(mat = lcpm_sym, net = net,
                       .source = "source", .target = "target",
                       .mor = "mor", minsize = 5)
cat(sprintf("Sample-level ULM: %d TFs x %d samples\n",
            n_distinct(sample_acts$source),
            n_distinct(sample_acts$condition)))
```

## 11.3 TF activity heatmap — all karyotypes

```{r decouple-heatmap-all, fig.height=12, fig.width=14}
n_tfs_dc <- 30
sample_acts_mat <- sample_acts %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols = "condition", names_from = "source",
              values_from = "score") %>%
  column_to_rownames("condition") %>%
  as.matrix()

tfs_var <- sample_acts %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(std = sd(score), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(-abs(std)) %>%
  head(n_tfs_dc) %>%
  pull(source)

hm_mat <- scale(sample_acts_mat[, tfs_var])

ann_row <- data.frame(Karyotype = dge$samples$karyotype,
                      row.names = rownames(hm_mat))
ann_colors <- list(Karyotype = karyotype_cols)
colors_use <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100)
my_breaks <- c(seq(-2, 0, length.out = 51),
               seq(0.05, 2, length.out = 50))

pheatmap(hm_mat, color = colors_use, breaks = my_breaks,
         border_color = "white",
         annotation_row = ann_row, annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         treeheight_row = 20, treeheight_col = 20,
         main = "decoupleR ULM: Top Variable TF Activities (All Karyotypes)")
```

## 11.4 TF activity heatmap — X0 vs XY subset

```{r decouple-heatmap-x0xy, fig.height=10, fig.width=14}
x0_xy_idx       <- dge$samples$karyotype %in% c("XO", "XY")
hm_mat_x0xy     <- hm_mat[x0_xy_idx, ]
ann_row_x0xy    <- data.frame(Karyotype = dge$samples$karyotype[x0_xy_idx],
                              row.names = rownames(hm_mat_x0xy))
ann_colors_x0xy <- list(Karyotype = karyotype_cols[c("XO", "XY")])

pheatmap(hm_mat_x0xy, color = colors_use, breaks = my_breaks,
         border_color = "white",
         annotation_row = ann_row_x0xy,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors_x0xy,
         treeheight_row = 20, treeheight_col = 20,
         main = "decoupleR ULM: Top Variable TF Activities (X0 vs XY)")
```

## 11.5 Contrast-level ULM (on limma t-statistics)

```{r decouple-contrast}
deg_df <- de_x0_xy %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(t), !is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol != "") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!gene_symbol %in% par_gene_names) %>%   # PAR strip at boundary
  distinct(gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_symbol, t) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(deg_df) <- deg_df$gene_symbol
deg_mat <- as.matrix(deg_df[, "t", drop = FALSE])

contrast_acts <- run_ulm(mat = deg_mat, net = net,
                         .source = "source", .target = "target",
                         .mor = "mor", minsize = 5)
cat(sprintf("Contrast-level ULM: %d TFs scored\n", nrow(contrast_acts)))
```

## 11.6 ULM TF activity bar plot

```{r decouple-bar, fig.height=7, fig.width=6}
n_show <- 25
f_contrast <- contrast_acts %>% mutate(rnk = NA_real_)
msk <- f_contrast$score > 0
f_contrast$rnk[msk]  <- rank(-f_contrast$score[msk])
f_contrast$rnk[!msk] <- rank(-abs(f_contrast$score[!msk]))

top_tfs_dc <- f_contrast %>%
  arrange(rnk) %>% head(n_show) %>% pull(source)

f_plot <- f_contrast %>%
  dplyr::filter(source %in% top_tfs_dc) %>%
  mutate(source = reorder(source, score))

bar_colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(2, 10)])

p_bar <- ggplot(f_plot, aes(source, score)) +
  geom_bar(aes(fill = score), color = "black",
           stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = bar_colors[1], mid = "whitesmoke",
                       high = bar_colors[2], midpoint = 0) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "TF Activity Score (ULM)",
       title = "decoupleR: Top TF Activities (X0 vs XY)") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        legend.position = "none")

print(p_bar)
save_fig(p_bar, "decoupleR_TF_barplot", width = 6, height = 7)
```

## 11.7 ULM volcano

```{r decouple-volcano, fig.height=5, fig.width=6}
dc_vol <- contrast_acts %>%
  mutate(sig = p_value < 0.05,
         direction = case_when(sig & score > 0 ~ "Activated",
                                sig & score < 0 ~ "Repressed",
                                TRUE ~ "NS"),
         direction = factor(direction,
                            levels = c("Repressed", "NS", "Activated")),
         nlp = -log10(pmax(p_value, 1e-50)))

dc_top <- bind_rows(
  dc_vol %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Activated") %>%
    slice_min(p_value, n = 10),
  dc_vol %>% dplyr::filter(direction == "Repressed") %>%
    slice_min(p_value, n = 10)
)
n_act_dc <- sum(dc_vol$direction == "Activated")
n_rep_dc <- sum(dc_vol$direction == "Repressed")

p_dc_vol <- ggplot(dc_vol, aes(score, nlp)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = direction), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05),
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text_repel(data = dc_top, aes(label = source),
                  size = 2.5, fontface = "bold.italic", max.overlaps = 30,
                  segment.color = "grey50", segment.size = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Repressed" = "#0072B2",
                                "NS"        = "grey80",
                                "Activated" = "#D55E00"),
                     drop = FALSE) +
  annotate("text", x = max(dc_vol$score) * 0.7,
           y = max(dc_vol$nlp) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("n = ", n_act_dc),
           color = "#D55E00", fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  annotate("text", x = min(dc_vol$score) * 0.7,
           y = max(dc_vol$nlp) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("n = ", n_rep_dc),
           color = "#0072B2", fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  labs(x = "TF Activity Score (ULM)",
       y = expression(-log[10]~"(p-value)"), color = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

print(p_dc_vol)
save_fig(p_dc_vol, "decoupleR_TF_volcano", width = 6, height = 5)
```

## 11.8 Target-gene scatter — top decoupleR TFs

```{r decouple-target-scatter, fig.height=8, fig.width=14}
top_act_dc <- contrast_acts %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_value < 0.05, score > 0) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>% head(3) %>% pull(source)
top_rep_dc <- contrast_acts %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_value < 0.05, score < 0) %>%
  arrange(p_value) %>% head(3) %>% pull(source)
scatter_tfs <- c(top_act_dc, top_rep_dc)

de_for_scatter <- de_x0_xy %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(t), !is.na(gene_symbol), gene_symbol != "") %>%
  distinct(gene_symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene_symbol, logFC, t, P.Value) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(de_for_scatter) <- de_for_scatter$gene_symbol

scatter_colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[c(2, 10)])

scatter_plots <- lapply(scatter_tfs, function(tf) {
  df <- net %>%
    dplyr::filter(source == tf) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(target) %>%
    distinct(target, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    as.data.frame()
  rownames(df) <- df$target

  inter <- sort(intersect(rownames(de_for_scatter), rownames(df)))
  if (length(inter) < 3) return(NULL)
  df <- df[inter, ]
  df[, c("logfc", "t_value", "p_value")] <-
    de_for_scatter[inter, c("logFC", "t", "P.Value")]

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(color = case_when(
      mor > 0 & t_value > 0 ~ "1",
      mor > 0 & t_value < 0 ~ "2",
      mor < 0 & t_value > 0 ~ "2",
      mor < 0 & t_value < 0 ~ "1",
      TRUE ~ "3"
    ))

  act_score <- contrast_acts %>%
    dplyr::filter(source == tf) %>% pull(score) %>% round(2)
  pv <- contrast_acts %>%
    dplyr::filter(source == tf) %>% pull(p_value) %>% signif(2)

  ggplot(df, aes(logfc, -log10(p_value), color = color)) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5, color = "black") +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(
      values = c("1" = scatter_colors[2],
                 "2" = scatter_colors[1],
                 "3" = "grey"),
      labels = c("1" = "Concordant", "2" = "Discordant", "3" = "Neutral"),
      name = "MoR") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = target),
                    size = 2, max.overlaps = 15, segment.size = 0.2) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dotted") +
    labs(title = paste0(tf, " (score=", act_score, ", p=", pv, ")"),
         x = expression(log[2]~"FC (X0 / XY)"),
         y = expression(-log[10]~"(P-value)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 9) +
    theme(legend.position = "top",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10))
})
scatter_plots <- compact(scatter_plots)

if (length(scatter_plots) > 0) {
  combined_scatter <- wrap_plots(scatter_plots, ncol = 3)
  print(combined_scatter)
  save_fig(combined_scatter, "decoupleR_target_scatter",
           width = 14, height = 8)
}
```

# 12. Cross-method TF consistency

Turner GSE126712 doesn't carry the matched paired-design + TCGA ARACNe
regulons that the LNCaP / A549 / HT1080 base notebooks integrate with
msVIPER, so the consistency axis here is a slimmer **two-method
agreement** between DoRothEA-fgsea (§10) and decoupleR-ULM CollecTRI
(§11). Both run on the same X0-vs-XY t-statistic ranking, with different
regulons and different inference engines, so concordance flags TFs that
robustly call X0-vs-XY independently of the regulon source.

## 12.1 Aggregate TF results

```{r tf-consistency-collect}
to_long <- function(df, tf_col, val_col, sig_expr, source_lab) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::transmute(TF     = .data[[tf_col]],
                     NES    = .data[[val_col]],
                     sig    = !!sig_expr,
                     source = source_lab)
}

tf_long <- bind_rows(
  to_long(tf_gsea,        "pathway", "NES",
          rlang::expr(padj < 0.05), "DoRothEA"),
  to_long(contrast_acts,  "source",  "score",
          rlang::expr(p_value < 0.05), "decoupleR_CollecTRI")
)

fwrite(tf_long, file.path(TF_DIR, "tf_consistency_long.csv"))

tf_long %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(tested = n(),
            sig    = sum(sig, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "TF result counts by source (X0 vs XY)")
```

## 12.2 Consistency heatmap (top robust TFs)

Heatmap NES of TFs significant in **both methods** (or with the highest
mean |NES| if fewer than the panel limit are dual-significant).

```{r tf-consistency-heatmap, fig.height=10, fig.width=6}
tf_score <- tf_long %>%
  group_by(TF) %>%
  summarise(sig_count          = sum(sig, na.rm = TRUE),
            abs_NES_mean       = mean(abs(NES), na.rm = TRUE),
            NES_direction_mean = mean(NES, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(sig_count), desc(abs_NES_mean))

dual_sig <- tf_score %>% dplyr::filter(sig_count >= 2) %>% pull(TF)
top_tfs_consistent <- if (length(dual_sig) >= 10) {
  head(dual_sig, 40)
} else {
  tf_score %>%
    dplyr::filter(sig_count >= 1) %>%
    slice_head(n = 40) %>% pull(TF)
}

cat(sprintf("TFs significant in both methods: %d   shown in heatmap: %d\n",
            length(dual_sig), length(top_tfs_consistent)))

if (length(top_tfs_consistent) > 0) {
  hm_cells <- expand.grid(
    TF     = top_tfs_consistent,
    source = c("DoRothEA", "decoupleR_CollecTRI"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

  hm_full <- hm_cells %>%
    left_join(tf_long %>% dplyr::select(TF, source, NES, sig),
              by = c("TF", "source")) %>%
    mutate(TF         = factor(TF, levels = rev(top_tfs_consistent)),
           source     = factor(source, levels = unique(hm_cells$source)),
           sig_marker = ifelse(isTRUE(sig) | (!is.na(sig) & sig), "*", ""))

  p_consist_hm <- ggplot(hm_full,
                         aes(source, TF, fill = NES)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_marker), color = "black",
              size = 3.5, vjust = 0.7) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0072B2", mid = "grey92", high = "#D55E00",
                         midpoint = 0, na.value = "grey80",
                         name = "NES / score") +
    labs(title = sprintf("TF cross-method consistency (top %d)",
                         length(top_tfs_consistent)),
         subtitle = "X0 vs XY; * = significant in that method.",
         x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 9) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1, size = 8),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face = "italic", size = 8),
          panel.grid  = element_blank(),
          plot.title  = element_text(face = "bold"))
  print(p_consist_hm)
  save_fig(p_consist_hm, "tf_consistency_heatmap", width = 6, height = 10)
}
```

## 12.3 Robust hits — TFs called by both methods

```{r tf-robust-hits}
sig_methods <- function(tf) {
  tf_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(TF == tf, sig) %>%
    dplyr::pull(source) %>% unique()
}

robust_tbl <- tf_score %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(sig_sources = paste(sig_methods(TF), collapse = ", "),
         n_methods   = length(sig_methods(TF))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::filter(n_methods >= 2) %>%
  arrange(desc(sig_count), desc(abs_NES_mean))

cat(sprintf("Robust Turner TFs (DoRothEA + decoupleR_CollecTRI both sig): %d\n",
            nrow(robust_tbl)))

fwrite(robust_tbl, file.path(TF_DIR, "tf_robust_hits.csv"))

if (nrow(robust_tbl) > 0) {
  robust_tbl %>%
    dplyr::select(TF, sig_count, NES_direction_mean, sig_sources) %>%
    head(30) %>%
    knitr::kable(digits = 2,
                 caption = "Top 30 robust Turner TFs (both methods agree)")
}
```

# 13. Cross-cohort overlap with LOY isogenic lines

The Turner X0-vs-XY signature describes whole-organism (lymphocyte) loss
of one X chromosome from conception. The three LOY isogenic cell lines
(A549, HT1080, LNCaP) describe targeted somatic loss of one Y
chromosome in adult cell culture. Both share the structural feature
"one fewer sex chromosome" but on a different axis (X vs Y; constitutive
vs induced). Genes that respond concordantly across both contexts are
candidates for a sex-chromosome-aneuploidy core signature; MYL9 in
particular has come up repeatedly in the LOY analyses and is worth
spotlighting here.

## 13.1 Load LOY cohort DE tables

```{r overlap-load}
# Canonical LOY DE outputs live under each cell-line subdirectory at the
# parent level. Each file is the paired LOY-vs-sgCTRL contrast (limma-voom
# with passage as block); columns gene_name / logFC / FDR / t are the ones
# we'll harmonize against the Turner table.
#
# Note: LNCaP base writes its paired DE under the (legacy) ht1080_-prefixed
# filename — the contents are LNCaP results, not HT1080. Path is correct.
loy_de_paths <- c(
  A549   = "../A549/DE/a549_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_paired.csv",
  HT1080 = "../HT1080/DE/ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_paired.csv",
  LNCaP  = "../LNCaP/DE/ht1080_LOY_v_sgCTRL_DE_paired.csv"
)

load_loy_de <- function(path, cohort) {
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    warning(sprintf("Missing LOY DE file for %s: %s", cohort, path))
    return(NULL)
  }
  fread(path, data.table = FALSE) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(
      gene   = gene_name,
      logFC  = logFC,
      FDR    = FDR,
      t      = t,
      cohort = cohort
    ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), nzchar(gene)) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)
}

loy_de_list <- Map(load_loy_de, loy_de_paths, names(loy_de_paths))
loy_de_long <- bind_rows(loy_de_list)

cat(sprintf("Loaded LOY DE tables: %s\n",
            paste(sprintf("%s = %d genes",
                          names(loy_de_list),
                          sapply(loy_de_list, NROW)),
                  collapse = "  |  ")))
```

## 13.2 Build unified per-gene table (Turner + 3 LOY cohorts)

```{r overlap-table}
turner_long <- de_x0_xy %>%
  dplyr::transmute(gene   = gene_symbol,
                   logFC  = logFC,
                   FDR    = adj.P.Val,
                   t      = t,
                   cohort = "Turner_X0_vs_XY") %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), nzchar(gene)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE)

all_long <- bind_rows(loy_de_long, turner_long) %>%
  mutate(cohort = factor(cohort,
                          levels = c("Turner_X0_vs_XY",
                                     "A549", "HT1080", "LNCaP")))

# Wide table for overlap counting: one row per gene, logFC/FDR per cohort
all_wide <- all_long %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, cohort, logFC, FDR) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = cohort,
              values_from = c(logFC, FDR),
              names_glue = "{cohort}_{.value}")

cat(sprintf("Unified table: %d unique genes across 4 cohorts\n",
            nrow(all_wide)))
```

## 13.3 DEG overlap summary

```{r overlap-summary}
sig_flag <- function(fdr) !is.na(fdr) & fdr < ALPHA

overlap_summary <- all_wide %>%
  mutate(
    turner_sig = sig_flag(Turner_X0_vs_XY_FDR),
    a549_sig   = sig_flag(A549_FDR),
    ht1080_sig = sig_flag(HT1080_FDR),
    lncap_sig  = sig_flag(LNCaP_FDR),
    n_loy_sig  = a549_sig + ht1080_sig + lncap_sig
  )

cat("=== DEG counts (FDR < 0.05, any direction) ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  Turner X0 vs XY            : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig)))
cat(sprintf("  A549   LOY vs sgCTRL        : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$a549_sig)))
cat(sprintf("  HT1080 LOY vs sgCTRL        : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$ht1080_sig)))
cat(sprintf("  LNCaP  LOY vs sgCTRL        : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$lncap_sig)))
cat("\n=== Turner ∩ LOY overlap ===\n")
cat(sprintf("  Turner ∩ A549              : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$a549_sig)))
cat(sprintf("  Turner ∩ HT1080            : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$ht1080_sig)))
cat(sprintf("  Turner ∩ LNCaP             : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$lncap_sig)))
cat(sprintf("  Turner ∩ (any LOY line)    : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$n_loy_sig >= 1)))
cat(sprintf("  Turner ∩ (>=2 LOY lines)   : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$n_loy_sig >= 2)))
cat(sprintf("  Turner ∩ all 3 LOY lines   : %d\n",
            sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$n_loy_sig == 3)))
```

```{r overlap-bar, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
overlap_counts <- tibble::tibble(
  category = c("Turner only",
               "Turner ∩ A549",
               "Turner ∩ HT1080",
               "Turner ∩ LNCaP",
               "Turner ∩ ≥2 LOY",
               "Turner ∩ all 3 LOY"),
  count = c(
    sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$n_loy_sig == 0),
    sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$a549_sig),
    sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$ht1080_sig),
    sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$lncap_sig),
    sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$n_loy_sig >= 2),
    sum(overlap_summary$turner_sig & overlap_summary$n_loy_sig == 3)
  )
) %>%
  mutate(category = factor(category, levels = category))

p_overlap_bar <- ggplot(overlap_counts, aes(category, count, fill = category)) +
  geom_col(color = "black", linewidth = 0.3, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = count), vjust = -0.4, size = 3.5,
            fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Turner only"          = "grey75",
    "Turner ∩ A549"        = "#0072B2",
    "Turner ∩ HT1080"      = "#009E73",

    "Turner ∩ ≥2 LOY"      = "#CC79A7",

print(p_overlap_bar)
```

## 13.4 Concordance scatter — Turner logFC vs LOY logFC

```{r overlap-scatter, fig.height=5, fig.width=15}
plot_concordance <- function(wide_df, loy_cohort, color) {
  fc_col  <- paste0(loy_cohort, "_logFC")
  fdr_col <- paste0(loy_cohort, "_FDR")
  d <- wide_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(.data[[fc_col]]),
                  !is.na(Turner_X0_vs_XY_logFC)) %>%
    mutate(both_sig = sig_flag(Turner_X0_vs_XY_FDR) & sig_flag(.data[[fdr_col]]),
           label = ifelse(both_sig & abs(.data[[fc_col]]) > 0.75 &
                            abs(Turner_X0_vs_XY_logFC) > 0.5,
                          gene, NA))
  rho <- cor(d[[fc_col]], d$Turner_X0_vs_XY_logFC,
             use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
  n_both <- sum(d$both_sig)

  ggplot(d, aes(.data[[fc_col]], Turner_X0_vs_XY_logFC)) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., !both_sig),
               color = "grey80", alpha = 0.3, size = 0.6) +
    geom_point(data = ~dplyr::filter(., both_sig),
               color = color, alpha = 0.85, size = 1.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0,
                linetype = "dotted", color = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), size = 2.5,
                    fontface = "italic", max.overlaps = 25,
                    segment.color = "grey40", segment.size = 0.2,
                    box.padding = 0.3, min.segment.length = 0.15) +
    labs(title = sprintf("%s LOY vs Turner X0", loy_cohort),
         subtitle = sprintf("Spearman ρ = %.2f   |   both-FDR<%.2f n = %d",
                            rho, ALPHA, n_both),
         x = expression(log[2]~"FC (LOY / sgCTRL)"),
         y = expression(log[2]~"FC (X0 / XY)")) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey30"))
}

concord_a549   <- plot_concordance(all_wide, "A549",   "#0072B2")
concord_ht1080 <- plot_concordance(all_wide, "HT1080", "#009E73")
concord_lncap  <- plot_concordance(all_wide, "LNCaP",  "#E69F00")

concord_combined <- concord_a549 + concord_ht1080 + concord_lncap +
  plot_layout(ncol = 3)
print(concord_combined)
save_fig(concord_combined, "overlap_concordance_scatter",
         width = 15, height = 5)
```

## 13.6 MYL9 spotlight

MYL9 (Myosin Light Chain 9, chr20q11.23) keeps surfacing in the LOY
analyses. It's a smooth-muscle/myofibroblast contractile gene also
expressed in non-muscle tissue as part of a stress-fibre /
mechanotransduction module. Pulling its row across all four cohorts and
visualising X0 expression directly:

```{r myl9-table}
myl9_row <- all_long %>% dplyr::filter(gene == "MYL9")
if (nrow(myl9_row) == 0) {
  cat("MYL9 not present in any DE table.\n")
} else {
  myl9_row %>%
    dplyr::select(cohort, logFC, FDR, t) %>%
    knitr::kable(digits = c(0, 3, 4, 3),
                 caption = "MYL9 — DE statistics across cohorts (LOY = LOY-vs-sgCTRL; Turner = X0-vs-XY)")
}
```

```{r myl9-boxplot, fig.height=4, fig.width=6}
myl9_idx <- which(dge$genes$gene_symbol == "MYL9")
if (length(myl9_idx) > 0) {
  myl9_expr <- tibble::tibble(
    sample    = colnames(lcpm),
    expression = lcpm[myl9_idx[1], ],
    karyotype = dge$samples$karyotype
  )

  p_myl9 <- ggplot(myl9_expr,
                    aes(karyotype, expression, fill = karyotype)) +
    geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, width = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.8, alpha = 0.7,
                color = "grey20") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = karyotype_cols) +
    labs(title = "MYL9 expression by karyotype (Turner GSE126712)",
         subtitle = "Same gene also called DE in HT1080 LOY (FDR ≈ 2e-4); see §13.6 table",
         x = NULL, y = expression(log[2]~"(CPM)"),
         fill = "Karyotype") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey30"))
  print(p_myl9)
  save_fig(p_myl9, "MYL9_expression_by_karyotype",
           width = 6, height = 4)
} else {
  cat("MYL9 not in Turner DGEList (filtered out at low-expression step).\n")
}
```

# 14. Save Results

```{r save-results}
export_de <- function(df, comparison) {
  if ("gene_id_full" %in% colnames(df)) {
    df %>% mutate(comparison = comparison)
  } else {
    df %>% rownames_to_column("gene_id_full") %>%
      mutate(comparison = comparison)
  }
}

# DE tables
fwrite(export_de(de_x0_xy, "X0_vs_XY"),
       file.path(DE_DIR, "X0_vs_XY_DE.csv"))
fwrite(export_de(de_x0_xx, "X0_vs_XX"),
       file.path(DE_DIR, "X0_vs_XX_DE.csv"))
fwrite(export_de(de_dose,  "dose_response"),
       file.path(DE_DIR, "dose_response_DE.csv"))

# log-CPM matrix (for downstream overlap analyses)
lcpm_export <- lcpm %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene_id_full") %>%
  left_join(dge$genes %>% dplyr::select(gene_id_full, gene_symbol),
            by = "gene_id_full")
fwrite(lcpm_export, file.path(DE_DIR, "lcpm_matrix.csv"))

# Sample metadata
sample_meta_export <- dge$samples %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  dplyr::select(sample, karyotype) %>%
  mutate(Group = karyotype)
fwrite(sample_meta_export, file.path(DE_DIR, "sample_meta.csv"))

# Histone-pathway GSEA (if computed)
if (exists("gsea_histone") && nrow(gsea_histone) > 0) {
  fwrite(gsea_histone %>%
           mutate(leadingEdge = sapply(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")),
         file.path(GSEA_DIR, "histone_gsea.csv"))
}

cat("=== Results saved ===\n")
cat("DE   :", DE_DIR,   "\n"); list.files(DE_DIR)   %>% print()
cat("GSEA :", GSEA_DIR, "\n"); list.files(GSEA_DIR) %>% print()
cat("TF   :", TF_DIR,   "\n"); list.files(TF_DIR)   %>% print()
cat("Figs :", FIG_DIR,  "\n"); list.files(FIG_DIR)  %>% print()
```
